name: app-6a7ec2575360819190063dd4bcf6bfb5
description: Ask ChatGPT about your OpenRevenue analytics — traffic, sources, funnels, and visitors.

interface.longDescription: Connect your OpenRevenue account and ask about pageviews, visitors, referrers, countries, funnels, goals, and Core Web Vitals. Uses the hosted OpenRevenue MCP with OAuth.
defaultPrompt: How did my top site do this week?
What are the top referrers for my project in the last 30 days?
Show funnel conversion for my signup funnel this month.

publication.release_notes: Adds skills for recent visitors, Core Web Vitals, and managing goals and funnels. Analytics tools now accept a fixed list of periods.
